The first public version of Bookmarks Pro for IINA.

**Download clips:** save the 5, 10 or 30 seconds after any bookmark to your Downloads folder, in full quality with sound.

- Press **B** to bookmark a moment, with a thumb of it.
- Press **N** to see your bookmarks over the video. Click one to jump there.
- Press **J** and **K** to go to the previous and next bookmark.
- Press **L** for a library of all your bookmarked videos.
- Back up your bookmarks with Export, and bring them back with Import.
- Hover previews and clips need [ffmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org) (`brew install ffmpeg`). Everything else works without it.

**Install:** download `Bookmarks-Pro-1.2.0.iinaplgz` below and double-click it, or in IINA go to **Settings → Plugins → Install from GitHub…** and type `aminozuur/iina-bookmarks-pro`. Requires IINA 1.4 or newer.
